caption: The drawing depicts a single hammer with a wooden handle and a metal head. The handle is colored in shades of light brown and beige, with visible wood grain texture and a few dark streaks. The hammer head is large, curved, and rust-colored, featuring a pronounced claw on one side and a flat striking surface on the other. There is a small, oval-shaped marking on the side of the metal head, and the head shows a realistic metallic texture with brown and reddish hues. The background is a plain, off-white color, and the composition centers the hammer diagonally across the page. The artist's name, "LeRoy Griffith," appears in small, gray letters in the lower right corner.
title: Adze
